create_runner_subclass: create a subclass of Runner that implements run, save_state, and load_state abstract methods
test_mockrunner: test the MockRunner class by instantiating with x, y, z values and calling run to get their sum
save_mockrunner_state: save the MockRunner state to a checkpoint directory as a JSON file using save_state
load_mockrunner_state: load a previously saved MockRunner state from a checkpoint directory using load_state
implement_preemptablemixin: implement PreemptableMixin in a Runner subclass to add STOPFAIR preemption detection and atomic checkpointing
